pcb.geometry: Actual unrouted tscircuit PCB and its component placement; supplied component OBJ models where available. Drawing-derived bodies remain approximate. DNP copper test pads appear in the PCB surface texture with no artificial component bodies.
pcb.routing: No copper routing. Wires in this assembly are external connection illustrations.

peltier.description: HiLetgo TEC1-12706 2-pack; the board drives one module
peltier.geometry: Amazon listing dimensional envelope, not manufacturer CAD. Ceramic plates and core are visual approximations; lead routing, diameter and length are illustrative. Confirm purchased samples before mechanical manufacture.

officialCadAttempts.result: Manufacturer offers CAD through TraceParts; no downloadable mesh obtained. Board uses the exact-part EasyEDA supplier mesh, which is not claimed to be manufacturer-authored.
Manufacturer-linked CAD export requires registered authorization. Use TI RYQ0021A drawing-derived 5 x 3 x 1 mm maximum-height package envelope where no supplier mesh is present.

assemblyLimitations: Connection and packaging visualization only. No heatsink, cold plate, clamping mechanism or thermal interface is specified by this assembly. Do not power a bare Peltier without an appropriate hot-side thermal assembly.

usbCables.description: Two Cable Matters 201440 USB-C to USB-C USB 2.0 data / 240 W / 5 A cables, 1 m option

roles.role: PD power from 100 W USB-C charger

usbCables.electricalRating: Manufacturer specifies up to 48 V / 5 A power delivery, an E-Marker, and USB 2.0 data up to 480 Mbps. Both roles can use this same cable product. Board data speed is determined by its USB implementation.
usbCables.geometry: Connection illustrations. Only short segments and board-side plugs are shown. Manufacturer does not publish plug/jacket CAD or dimensions; shapes and role colors are indicative, not fit-qualified geometry. Cable slack, charger end and PC end are omitted.
